task.pr_title: Add new triggers, sources and sinks to policies

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
I worry about how we do this...
Whats stopping the non-admin user making an automation which just reads config folder and grabs all settings and secrets...
We need to ensure folder scanning doesnt run on SaaS mode, and on non desktop it should probably be Admin only 
+ have  blacklists like our db/settings files

evidence.thread_resolution: jbrunton96: Should be sorted now. I've added in an allow list for folders that it can look in in the user's settings, and also guarded it by admin and saas, for a belt and braces approach. I'd rather keep it super locked down for now and ease up in the future when we start testing it in anger.
